summary: IEEE ICRA 2026 opened in Vienna at VIECON, running June 1–5 as the flagship IEEE Robotics and Automation Society conference. The meeting is expected to draw about 8,000 robotics researchers, academics, and industry participants to share current work through research sessions, workshops, and tutorials.

title: 휴로틱스, 세계적 재활로봇 허브 美 시카고 UIC에 'H-Medi' 수출
summary: Hurotics has exported its H-Medi soft wearable gait-rehabilitation robot to the University of Illinois Chicago, placing the device inside one of the major U.S. clusters for rehabilitation robotics. UIC plans to use H-Medi across its physical therapy program and with affiliated hospitals and research institutes, making the deal less a one-off sale than an entry point for clinical and research collaborations in the Chicago rehab ecosystem.

title: Ambassadors of STEM
summary: MIT students who previously competed in FIRST Robotics have formed a new club aimed at bringing hands-on STEM enrichment to K-12 students. The effort matters less as a technical robotics advance than as an outreach pipeline: it channels experienced student roboticists into mentoring and educational programming for younger learners.
